summary: ```markdown # Flattening Improvements | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive ## Introduction Hey everyone, it's Phoebe, and I have some great updates to share with you for our flattening tool. So let's dive on in and have some fun while we learn! ## Updates to the Flattening Tool We've had some really nice updates when it comes to our flattening tool, especially with our own Clo avatars. Additionally, we've made significant improvements for importing other OBJs and flattening patterns on them. ### Enhancements for Clo Avatars We ensured that all the great updates for our own avatars, such as a nicely laid-out design that accurately represents the front and back of the avatar, are also applied to our OBJs. ### Working with OBJs Here, I have an OBJ where I’ve put some lines on her. Now I'm ready to go to my flattening tool, which is located in my 3D window and 3D toolbar. You can see options like the Edit 3D Pen Avatar, the 3D Pen Avatar Tool, and the Flattening tool. ## Selecting Patterns to Flatten To flatten patterns, I can hold down Shift to select the patterns I want to flatten. I’ll select these patterns, but I don’t want the one over here to be flattened. After selecting, I simply hit Enter. Now, everything is nicely laid out. I can see my front, side, and back clearly. ### Adjusting Selections I realized I forgot to hit one of the patterns. No problem! I can go to my pen tool, hold down Control to create curve points, and finish my selection. ## Finalizing the Flattening Process Now, I can return to my flattening tool, select the newly adjusted pattern, and hit Enter again. This setup is much nicer! The patterns are now sewn together because I flattened them as a group. If I want to edit the patterns further, I can select and delete specific ones. After that, I can go back to the flattening tool and flatten them together again. ### Placement and Sewing The placement of the patterns is excellent. This feature is particularly useful for handling objects like this. I can select all the flattening places and hit Enter to see the nice placement of components. I can rotate the object around to position it as needed. If I find that something should be adjusted, I can easily do that. ## Conclusion Everything is sewn together really nicely, making the workflow much more efficient. This update is incredibly helpful and user-friendly. Thank you so much for watching! If you have any questions, please use the comment section down below. Don’t forget to like and subscribe, and check out our YouTube channel for more great videos to help you learn. Keep having fun in Clo! Bye! ```
